mode.description: shift_mean / shift_median: move the frame's mean / median onto train's; standardize: also rescale std; robust: median + IQR; quantile: map onto train's quantile function
mode.title: Mode

group.description: Column: align per group (statistics fitted on train); unseen or small groups fall back to the global statistics
group.title: Group

min_rows.description: Fewer non-null frame values than this leaves the column (or group) unchanged
min_rows.title: Min Rows

on_small.description: A column with fewer than min_rows values
on_small.title: On Small
